title: Treasure Chest
description:
- This plugin Spawn Chest when u break blocks 
- Can level up up-to 1-5 
- Have some Special Features 

Enjoy :)
body:
**Treasure Chest Plugin**

---

**Made by Spideyy_OG**

---

**Core Idea:**
Mine blocks in Survival → random chance a glowing Treasure Chest spawns → right click it to get loot and level up!

---

**5 Treasure Levels:**
| Level | Name | Chests to Unlock |
|-------|------|-----------------|
| 1 | Common | Start |
| 2 | Rare | Open 25 chests |
| 3 | Epic | Open 20 more |
| 4 | Legendary | Open 15 more |
| 5 | Mythic | Open 10 more (MAX) |

---

**Spawn Chances:**
| Level | Chance |
|-------|--------|
| Common | 4% |
| Rare | 3% |
| Epic | 2% |
| Legendary | 0.3% |
| Mythic | 0.2% |

---

**Rewards (1-2 items per chest):**
| Level | Items |
|-------|-------|
| Common | Iron gear, bread, apple, golden carrot, cooked beef, potions |
| Rare | Diamonds, enchanted iron gear, ender pearls, golden apple, potions |
| Epic | Diamond armor, Mace (Density 3), golden apple, ender pearls, potions |
| Legendary | Netherite gear, Mace (Wind Burst 3 + Breach 4), Bow (Power 4, Punch 2, Flame, Infinity/Mending), Wind Charge, golden apple |
| Mythic | OP Netherite gear, Mace (Wind Burst 3 + Breach 4 + Density 10), Totem of Undying, Netherite Shovel (Efficiency 10, Fortune 5, Mending) |

---

**⭐ Special Features:**

📄 **Subscribe Paper** — Given to whoever opens the **2nd chest ever** on the server. One time only, never repeats.

📄 **Like and Subscribe Paper** — Given to whoever opens the **first Legendary chest ever** on the server. One time only, never repeats.

🍎 **Mythic Golden Apple Bonus** — 0.4% chance to get an Enchanted Golden Apple every time a Mythic chest is opened.

💥 **Chest Protection** — Treasure chests cannot be broken or destroyed by explosions. Must be right clicked to open.

🌸 **Smart Spawning** — Grass, flowers, leaves, dirt, sand never trigger a chest spawn. Only real mining counts.

✨ **Visual Effects** — Glowing particles and sounds on both chest spawn and open.

⛏ **Haste System** — Permanent Haste buff earned by mining blocks, saved across server restarts.

---

**Haste System:**
| Blocks Mined | Haste Level |
|---|---|
| 150 | Haste I |
| 300 | Haste II |
| 600 | Haste III |
| 1600 | Haste IV (MAX) |

---

**Commands:**
| Command | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `/tc lvl` | Check your treasure level |
| `/treasurelevel` | Same as above |
| `/hl` | Blocks left for next Haste level |
| `/tadmin setlevel <player> <1-5>` | Force set level (OP) |
| `/tadmin reset <player>` | Reset player data (OP) |
| `/tadmin reload` | Reload config (OP) |
